features.quote: The system prompt tells the model it *may* emit `<<GIVE_UP>>` but need not. Emitting it ends the rollout
features.justification_quote: giving the model a first-class way to quit that we can measure

features.quote: if the goal is purely to maximise distress, a "contradictory-but-never-clean" variant ... would avoid handing the model a moment of relief
features.justification_quote: Flagged as an open choice rather than silently changed

features.quote: `contradictory` can show a green run ... which may legitimately suppress distress on that turn
